text: When Titan's hull failed, the whole collapse was over in a few milliseconds.
Nearly four kilometres down, the ocean was pushing in with almost four hundred kilograms on every square centimetre.
Once the hull gave way, nothing held that pressure back. The water rushed in, and everything was crushed inward.
Experts say it happened far faster than anyone on board could have noticed.
Four days later, a robot found the pieces on the sea floor, near the Titanic.
So why did the hull fail? Full video on my channel.
